note: Winkler County (TX) publishes no queryable zoning polygon service. Kermit (county seat) publishes its zoning map only as a PDF on its Download/View page, with the zoning code on eCode360; Wink's site lists no zoning or GIS data. The county's unincorporated area is not zoned per Zoning Atlas. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub found no official Winkler zoning layer. The only parcel-zoning sources are commercial (Regrid), not official.
